# Default Compiler and Public Demo Plan

> The Awtsmoos renews hidden semantic depth and visible public proof in one light; Awtsmoos.com now lets the smallest doorway compile something real while every claim remains measured and right.

## Evidence incorporated

- `geelooy` is the real dynamic server public root.
- A file tree at `geelooy/apps/universal-procedural/` therefore maps naturally to `/apps/universal-procedural/`.
- High-level `createAwtsmoos()` now installs the established ModelingDocument compiler bridge when it owns the semantic kernel.
- Low-level/caller-owned semantic kernels remain isolated unless explicitly opted in.
- The default bridge and facade policy pass 26 integration/regression tests together.

## Public proof architecture

The demo will import the real universal API from `/libs/awtsmoos-procedural-core/src/index.js` and register one deterministic browser-only visualization compiler plugin for multiple noun-neutral kinds. It will not copy or mock the lifecycle engine.

The visualization compiler produces a renderer-neutral visual model. A separate SVG renderer converts that artifact model into DOM. Five authored scenarios will exercise the same API: stone arch, layered building, mature olive tree, mechanical assembly, and river/terrain. Plans and explanation panels will show compiler chain, channels, constraints, support states, quality/budget, cache, and provenance.
